entities.name: EPS security context
entities.description: Security parameters for authentication, integrity protection and ciphering tied together and identified by eKSI. Can be native or mapped type.

entities.name: Key set identifier for E-UTRAN
entities.description: Identifies EPS security context. Consists of value and type parameter indicating native or mapped security context.

entities.name: EPS authentication procedure
entities.description: Procedure between MME and UE that creates EPS security context.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by MME to take EPS security context into use.

entities.name: Inter-system handover procedure
entities.description: Handover from A/Gb mode to S1 mode or Iu mode to S1 mode where mapped EPS security context is derived.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message that contains eKSI in NAS key set identifier IE.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message that contains eKSI indicating current EPS security context.

entities.name: NAS key set identifier IE
entities.description: Information element that carries eKSI in initial NAS messages.

relations.description: EPS security context is identified by eKSI.
EPS authentication procedure creates EPS security context.
Security mode control procedure takes EPS security context into use.
Inter-system handover procedure derives mapped EPS security context.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains NAS key set identifier IE with eKSI.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains NAS key set identifier IE with eKSI.
EPS security context management depends on EMM-REGISTERED state.
EPS security context storage and invalidation depends on EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
